title: New Austin Hotel, Hyde Park Street Plans
summary:
*   Approved a permit for the new Texas Hotel to erect a smoke stack at Congress Avenue and East 7th Street, signaling downtown development.
*   Received and filed a petition from Hyde Park residents requesting the opening of a section of East 40th Street between Avenue "H" and Duval Street.
*   Granted a temporary permit for the Robbins Company to close a sidewalk on Congress Avenue for a few hours.

SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
Austin, Texas. March 16.1923.
The Council was called to order by the Mayor. Roll call showed the following members
present: Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres, and Searight, 4; absent, Councilman
Haynes.
The application of Roy L. Thomas, Architect for the Texas Hotel Company, to erect a smoke
stack in the rear of the new hotel at the corner of Congress Avenue and East 7th Street,
was read and Councilman Copeland moved that the permit be granted. Motion prevailed by the
following vote: Ayes,.....
Mayor Yett, Councilmen. Copeland, and Searight, nayes, Councilman Eyres, Councilman Haynes
absent.
The Council then recessed,
SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
Austin, Texas, March 17,1923,
The Council was called to order by the Mayor.
Roll call showed the following members present; Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres,
Haynes and Searight, 5; absent, none.
The application of the Robbins Company for permission to close the sidewalk in front of
914 Congress Avenue for a few hours on Monday, March 19, 1923, was granted by the
following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres, Haynes and Searight, 5;
nayes, none, The petition of V. D. Fugler and other residents of Hyde Park to open a part
of East 40th Street between Avenue "H" and Duval Street was read and ordered filed,
The Council then adjourned.
